extra.reason: Investigated: no Dolt adapter needed; bd status + metadata already model the pipeline. Replacing planned scope with a small git adapter for branch/merge-ancestry checks instead — folded into bead A.

Done. src/sources/adapters.rs adds GcAdapter/BdAdapter/GitAdapter traits + CliGc/CliBd/LocalGit impls + an Adapters bundle; assemble/render/main now depend only on the traits. Dropped the planned Dolt adapter per oilcop-bb9.4's finding, added a small GitAdapter (merge-ancestry check) instead. Verified: status/queue/agents behave identically against live carbon-city after the refactor; 0 clippy warnings.

Done. New 'oil-cop dag <rig>' command (+ folded into 'watch <rig>'): renders beads as a tree/git-graph via parent/child, with 'blocked by' annotations for cross-tree blocks edges. --json emits nodes with parent/blocked_by for scripting. Verified live against luminate (84 nodes, correct tree grouping under epics like luminate-2vr/bgb/wl7/lpm) -- and it immediately surfaced luminate-bjj ('polecats close beads without pushing branches -- completed work strands locally, never reaches master'), which is exactly the refinery-not-merging bug motivating this bead.

Done. BeadStage enum (Pending/Active/Merged) + bead_stage_glyph in render/color.rs: red for pending, yellow flashing (alternates bold/plain each watch tick) for active, green static for merged. Also added a 'landed_unmerged' flag (via GitAdapter) for in_progress beads whose branch already merged into target in git -- the stuck-refinery signal. Verified color codes via pty capture (31m red / 1;33m bold yellow / 32m green) and JSON stage classification against live luminate data.
Epic complete: adapters refactored (gc/bd/git traits), dag dashboard shipped, bead-stage color animation shipped. Dolt adapter scoped out and dropped per investigation.

Done. src/config.rs: FileConfig (city/stale_after/default_rig), merges global ~/.config/oil-cop/config.toml under a project-local .oilcop.toml (walking up from cwd like gc's own city.toml discovery); CLI flags always win. Wired into main.rs for city/stale_after and rig fallback across queue/agents/dag/watch. Verified: config-only invocation works, CLI override wins, clear error when neither rig nor default_rig is set. README documents the file format.

Done. Each Health variant now has a distinct shape (healthy=●, idle=◇, stale=▲, dead=✕, suspended=‖, done=✓, unknown=?) and each BeadStage its own (pending=○, active=◐, merged=✓ -- deliberately reusing bd's own status glyph vocabulary). Verified with --no-color: agents/dag output is now fully distinguishable without any color at all. README tables updated with the actual glyphs.

Done. New 'oil-cop check [rig]' command: city-wide health always, plus one rig's in-progress beads + agents if given. Only Dead/Stale count as failures (Unknown/partial-status is uncertainty, not a proven problem, so it doesn't fail the gate). Exit 0/1, --json emits {ok, issues[]}. Verified against live carbon-city: clean exit 0 at default threshold, 11 itemized issues + exit 1 when forced stale via --stale-after 1m.

Done. RigView gains a bead_summary: Option<QueueSummary> field; city_view now takes &Adapters and calls bd.status() per non-suspended rig (suspended rigs skip the call -- nothing useful to show). status's rig table gains READY/WIP/BLOCKED columns; --json includes the same per rig. Verified against live carbon-city: luminate shows 59/5/15, suspended rigs show '-'.
Done. 'oil-cop completion <shell>' via clap_complete, supports bash/zsh/fish/elvish/powershell. Verified zsh/bash/fish all emit valid scripts. README documents install paths.
v0.2 feature set complete: config file support, distinct glyph shapes per state (no-color/colorblind), oil-cop check, per-rig bead counts in status, shell completions.
